notes.title: Escalation Update is now live! New Game Mode, New maps, New Mechanic!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1][h2]Escalation Game Mode[/h2][p]This is an evolution of the [b]Skirmish[/b] mode, where you compete on randomized levels to be the first to accumulate enough points, and between rounds you get to [b]upgrade[/b] your towers and add [b]new passives[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Note, to unlock this mode you need to win a [b]single[/b] skirmish match![/p][p][/p][h2]Resistance/Vulnerability System[/h2][p]Attacks now have damage types, and different units/towers are vulnerable/resistant to these attacks.[/p][p][/p][h2]Unit Info Screen[/h2][p]There is now a screen that gives the detailed info on units and structures stats, including their new resistances/vulnerabilities. Check it out![/p][p][/p][h2]New Missions[/h2][p]The final two missions of the Chromatech campaign have been released, with a level playing with a Wave Attack mode intended for the global domination game mode, and a climatic showdown with the U.C.F..[/p][p]
Pay attention for some hints of the next faction![/p][p][/p][h2]New Tower Upgrades/Passives[/h2][p]We added a few more upgrades and passives now that Escalation mode is out and you can use them there.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Map[/h2][p][b]Bastion[/b]: A new dual Wave Defence / Skirmish map designed by a member of the community.[/p][p][/p][h1]Updates/Bug Fixes[/h1][p][/p][h2]Sniper Tower Rework[/h2][p]The sniper tower wasn’t as fun as we wanted, so we redid the way it works, it now fires all the time normally, and if you hover over a target in range and los it will focus it, instead of focusing the player’s cursor at all times.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Nerfed Field Promotion for being way too OP[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some scoreboard bugs and made it so you can see the global high score without having to have a score of your own first.[/p][/*][*][p]Tuning powers/structures for better balance[/p][/*][*][p]Continued to improve performance[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved/optimized pathfinding for better performance and less units getting stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of localization issues
[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124850/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for playing, and as always – we love hearing your feedback. [url="https://discord.gg/kr84wGn4xu"]Join the discussion[/url], share your chaos combos, and let us know what you think!   

- RattleAxe Games[/p]

notes.title: Summer Discount&Update is now live! New Feature, New maps, New System!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1][h2]Flying Units and Structures[/h2][p]Both factions have received a new unit, and a structure to produce that unit.[/p][list][*][p][b]Helicopter[/b]: The UCF now have an attack helicopter that can hover over water to capture territories. Produced by the Helipad.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Zedplin[/b]: Chromatech now have a hot air balloon that fires zombies, which excels at hunting down enemy artillery. Produced by the Rigor Riser.
[/p][/*][/list][p]This also comes with a new passive available in Wave Defence, [b]Air Commander[/b], that allows you to take to the field to directly control air units![/p][h2]New Modifier[/h2][p]The [b]Happening [/b]modifier has been added to both wave defence and skirmish modes. This modifier allows for various events to occur. Right now just the Blood Moon, raising all corpses as neutral zombies, and Lightning Storm, however more will be added as time goes on.[/p][h2]New Commanders[/h2][p]Each faction got a new Commander, with a new power and one new passive.[/p][list][*][p][b]Instructor[/b]: The UCF got a commander with the Field Promotion power, upgrading all grunts in range to the nearest special tile. Their passive grants bonus stats to elite units.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Economist[/b]: Chromatech got a commander with Zombonomics, a power that converts zombies in the area into bonus stock for the nearby territories.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Missions[/h2][p]The next two Chromatech missions chronicling Dr. Strangehue’s quest for revenge have been released, bringing the Chromatech campaign to near the end and featuring the new flying units.[/p][p][/p][h2]Global High Scores[/h2][p]Campaign and Wave Defence maps now have the option to see the global high scores close to you, so you can compete to be the best in the world![/p][p][/p][h2]New Map[/h2][p][b]Wing Tide[/b]: A new dual Wave Defence / Skirmish map focusing on aerial units[/p][p][/p][h2]Handicap/Bonus System[/h2][p]There is now an option in skirmish games to add a bonus or handicap to human players. This allows for novice players to fight on even footing with more experienced ones.[/p][p][/p][h2]Wave Defence Economy Revamp[/h2][p]Structures that produced bonus resources were too strong in Endless Mode, so they were reduced by ½ in that mode (single resource structures go down to a 50% chance of getting 1). Also, a new structure, the Bank, has been added as a potential Permastructure in the store in Wave Defence. This gives 2 resources per wave in Wave Defence and 1 in Endless.[/p][p][/p][h1]Updates/Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Continued to juice the effects of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Tuning powers/structures for better balance[/p][/*][*][p]Continued to improve performance[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved/optimized pathfinding for better performance and less units getting stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Made waves 20+ harder on Endless Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a variety of localization issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some crash bugs related to unit removal/summoning
[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124850/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for playing, and as always – we love hearing your feedback. [url="https://discord.gg/kr84wGn4xu"]Join the discussion[/url], share your chaos combos, and let us know what you think!   

- RattleAxe Games[/p]

notes.title: Game Mode Update Streaming
notes.notes:
Commanders! A new update has landed for D.O.T. Defence, packed with new modes, missions, maps, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:

[h3]🎮 New Skirmish Modes![/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Boss Mode[/b]: Replace your HQ with a super unit and dive into twin-stick shooter combat!
[*] [b]Armistice Mode[/b]: Ceasefires after a set time give you space to regroup and rebuild.
[*] [b]Warzone Mode[/b]: Face off against relentless Shadow Government waves – or use the chaos to crush your enemies.
[/list]
[i]These modes can be combined for ultimate mayhem.[/i]

[h3]🧪 New Campaign Missions[/h3]
Dr. Strangehue’s revenge continues with two new Chromatech missions, marking the halfway point of the campaign.

[h3]💥 Campaign Difficulty + Scoring[/h3]
Choose your challenge! Now with difficulty settings and a scoring system that rewards high-skill play, it's perfect for competing with friends.

[h3]🗺️ New Maps[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Logic Gates[/b]: 1v1 Chromatech biome map for tight tactical battles.
[*] [b]Dead End[/b]: A new wave defence map where barricade placement is key to survival.
[/list]

[h3]🕹️ Keyboard + Gamepad Co-op[/h3]
No more extra controllers needed! Play local co-op using just a single gamepad + keyboard/mouse setup.

[h3]🔧 Other Improvements + Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New faction art by [url=https://www.instagram.com/timlmack/]Tim Mack[/url]
[*] Clearer metaprogression alerts
[*] Buffs to expensive structures
[*] Pathfinding optimisations
[*] Harder Endless Mode (waves 20+)
[*] Crash & localisation fixes
[*] Screenshake toggle
[*] Improved team AI in Skirmish
[*] Wave defence balance: bonus resources now require early placement
[/list]

Thanks for playing, and as always – we love hearing your feedback. [url=https://discord.gg/kr84wGn4xu]Join the discussion[/url], share your chaos combos, and let us know what you think! 

- RattleAxe Games

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/14/2024
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Commanders![/h2]

We’re excited to bring you another update for D.O.T. Defence! Here’s what’s new and improved:


[h3]Localization[/h3]
We’ve added support for new languages:

[u]Chinese[/u]
[u]French[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/c614cea189b8c3c48a4e124163a33127fa18ccd0.png[/img]
A language selector is now available in the game menu, and if no language is detected, the game will default to the main menu where you can select the appropriate flag! 

[h3]New Maps[/h3]
Explore and conquer our two new maps:

[b][u]Hue Silo[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/6b19eeb51b55ba166f8f853fe44823bfaa6b4870.jpg[/img]
[b][u]Bridge Maze[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/56df1b734e5812ec6845eac489ee065349a1f338.jpg[/img]

[h3]UI and UX Improvements[/h3]
We’ve made key enhancements to improve your experience:
-Redesigned the map select screen for a cleaner layout and improved button colors.
-Improved overall feedback across the UI, ensuring better clarity in key interactions.

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]
We’ve refined gameplay flow to speed up downtime and increase strategic depth:
-AI pathfinding now takes distance into account for more tactical movement.
-Trucks now move faster between waves, reducing downtime.

[h3]Map Adjustments[/h3]
We’ve made tweaks to the maps for smoother gameplay:
-Completed tuning of the Bridge Maze for a more balanced challenge.
-Added line drawing for bridges in Mission 2.
-Final path node now automatically rotates to face the last node’s direction.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/2fcb1253d313e9621b8db18fdb20247a1c9a7948.png[/img]
We’ve resolved several bugs to improve overall stability:
-Fixed viewport snap issues for smoother transitions.
-The bridge on Hue Silo is now part of the navigation layer.
-Updated compendium videos and screenshots where needed.
-Fixed "power ready" bark in wave defense.
-Improved mouse UI for player selection.
-Fixed an issue where the player selection slot wasn’t displayed.
-Smoothed out long jump stitching in mouse line drawing.
-Dropdown menus now correctly consume back input.

Also today we're featured during Steam Next Fest! Please check it out and give us a review on our Steam Demo Page, it'll be a huge help to our game. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/9a157426b347bab33ced2eb5071aa2d28c4c15dc.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates! Thank you for your continued support, and keep sharing your feedback, videos, and art as we refine D.O.T. Defence.

Best regards,
The RattleAxe Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 10/6/2024
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Commanders![/h3]
We’re excited to bring you another update for D.O.T. Defence! Here’s what’s new and improved:

[h2]New Features & Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Single Player Missions Added![/h3]
The campaign is here! We’re introducing the first three single-player missions, each offering unique challenges to test your strategy and sharpen your skills:

[u][h3]Mission 1: [/h3][/u]Ready for action with Paradrops! Your goal: Defend the HQ from relentless assaults.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/d40b2c6d67ccf7698388854feacfcf6d13cd4832.png[/img]
[u][h3]Mission 2:[/h3][/u] A timed mission with high stakes. Capture the facility before it wipes out your HQ!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/fb59815bcd03c2be9d2167fcd2e0e4f61209e87f.png[/img]
[u][h3]Mission 3: [/h3][/u]Command a Super Tank and show those Blues who’s in charge!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/58b0d56f6be9a74408c39c3bfcd379e4a5bc1bcf.png[/img]

[h3]New Trailer[/h3]

Our new [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMbHgF8Dsms]trailer[/url] showcases a lot of the above missions and how you can go about picking and choosing the levels! We're especially happy to implement the previously mentioned Possession mechanic! Check it out!
[previewyoutube=gMbHgF8Dsms;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]



[h3]Turret Buffs[/h3]
Turrets are now more powerful! We’ve increased their Time to Kill (TTK) to make them deadlier, ensuring a more satisfying defense experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/6ef6e6e85fa09fca3096876b194f8198e9c8a135.png[/img]

[h3]New Portraits[/h3]
New character portraits have been added! You can now choose from additional AI and female portraits, offering more personalization options for your commander.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/ccaa3b5c2596228261a846f0e70d788f0320cce9.png[/img]
[h3]General Animation Updates[/h3]
Our UI has received a facelift with smoother animations, making it more fluid and responsive. The game feels sharper and more polished than ever before!

[h3]Quality of Life Enhancements [/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/2fcb1253d313e9621b8db18fdb20247a1c9a7948.png[/img]
[h3]Additional Tooltips[/h3]
To improve accessibility, we’ve added more tooltips throughout the game. These will help you quickly grasp key mechanics and features, whether you’re a new player or a seasoned veteran.

[h3]General Optimizations[/h3]
We’ve enhanced pathfinding and unit handling to improve overall movement, making your units more responsive and agile on the battlefield.


[h2]What’s Coming Up?[/h2]
We’ve been gearing up for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and other game festivals! Expect more exciting features, announcements, and improvements in the coming weeks as we continue to refine and expand D.O.T. Defence. We've also been hard at work continuing on localization, with the furthest progress on French, so stay tuned for that fellow francophones!

[h3]Stay Connected![/h3]

We couldn’t do this without you. Your support helps us grow, so keep making videos, art, and sharing your experiences with D.O.T. Defence. Be sure to follow our [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gMbHgF8Dsms]youtube[/url], [url=https://x.com/axe_rattle]twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@rattleaxe.games]tiktok[/url] channels! Together, we’ll build something amazing!


Best regards,
The RattleAxe Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 9/23/2024 - D.O.T. Defence
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Commanders![/h3]

We’re happy to bring you our third exciting update for D.O.T. Defence! Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Dyslexia-Friendly Font:[/h3] We’ve switched to a new dyslexia-friendly font. Not only does it enhance readability, but we’ve also come to love the new look. We hope it makes your experience even smoother.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/c7add07a0ead20f5997dc53512ead88862e3229d.png[/img]

[h3]Campaign Missions:[/h3] We’ve begun work on the game’s campaign! These missions will guide players through essential skills and strategies, teaching you how to effectively master the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/e4e343e020fc1079ec37c3620854a8b5e30450e6.png[/img]

[h3]Interactive Environment - Bridges: [/h3]You can now interact with bridges in the environment! Blow them up to hinder enemy advances or repair them to guide your forces in a more tactical approach. Strategic use of bridges will now become key in your defense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/3e7a32413979654dbc5f48edefd9e971ccaddad3.png[/img]


[h3]New Commander Ability - Paradrop:[/h3] Paratroopers have arrived! Use the new Paradrop ability to bring reinforcements into battle. Be aware, though—one recruit is still learning the ropes, so they may jump a little early!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/e5d3fb1cb34b8a5f60c5cedd18614a1a84dc6dfd.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Exciting Features in Testing[/u][/b][/h2]

[h3]Special Unit Control: [/h3]We’re currently testing a feature that may allow for direct control of a special unit! It’s still in the early stages, so we’ll reveal more in future updates. Stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/5d963fdfe9ff3c8b8a6cb9929548c008bb0709cd.png[/img]

[h3]Super Structures:[/h3] We’re also testing super structures that you’ll need to capture. These structures will come with special win conditions, adding a fresh layer of strategy to the game. They’re not available just yet as we need to playtest them further, but they’re on the horizon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/fb59815bcd03c2be9d2167fcd2e0e4f61209e87f.png[/img]


[h2][b][u]Tileset and Biomes[/u][/b][/h2]

[h3]Bog Biome: [/h3]We’re testing a new biome—bogs. Units and vehicles will move slower in these swampy areas, adding a new layer of challenge. On the flip side, vehicles will speed up when moving on roads.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/24a24ce445514ded62ec5b914bc489b9b03af0e6.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Tuning and Balancing[/u][/b][/h2]

We’ve done significant balancing and tuning for various structures, powers, and units to complement new commander abilities. Expect smoother gameplay and more strategic possibilities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/2fcb1253d313e9621b8db18fdb20247a1c9a7948.png[/img]

[h2][b][u]Taunt System[/u][/b][/h2]

[h3]New Taunt System:[/h3] Taunts are now available in the main menu and on the scoreboard. We’re testing out female voice options for these, so be sure to check them out and let us know what you think!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/3c4e93aa824483dd1b78f46589029f285628c0e9.png[/img]

[h3][b][i]What’s Next?[/i][/b][/h3]

We’ll continue refining the campaign missions, expand on commander abilities, and work toward introducing these exciting new features. Additionally, we’re focusing on leaderboards and improving the game’s accessibility through localization.

[h3][b]Stay Connected![/b][/h3]

Follow us on [url=https://x.com/axe_rattle]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@rattleaxegames12]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3124850/discussions/]Steam[/url] for the latest updates. Your feedback keeps us going strong!

[h3][b]Thank You![/b][/h3]

Your ongoing support is invaluable. Keep playing, reviewing, and sharing D.O.T. Defence with your friends!

Best regards,

The RattleAxe Games Team

notes.title: Patch Notes 9/4/2024 - D.O.T. Defence
notes.notes:
Greetings Commanders!

We're excited to share the latest updates for D.O.T. Defence!

:wrench: New Features & Improvements
[list]

[b]- Added map preview art:[/b] We've added a system to display a simplified preview when you're selecting a map. This will let you better view what to expect when you jump into the game. More maps in general are to come!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/34d35968106258de81a00e7380450aebc42929c5.png[/img]

[b]-Updated Tileset:[/b] We've enhanced the visuals with new isocubes to better convey depth and improve readability. So far this is a first pass at the new system, but it's more modular than ever and will let us decorate the heck out of our current and future maps!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/84f933ade4d9f6b788e4fcda73cb6a8e59435840.png[/img]


[b]-Wave Defense Leaderboard System:[/b] This feature is still being developed, however if you or other friends over steam wish to battle for the highest score in our PvE mode, now you can! At the end of a match, press the Y button to toggle the leaderboard list next to your overall score.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159983/e300c1730eab4b8c1e5d70f29af435ad240e5158.png[/img]
